evidence: Video: horizontal oval translucent orange-brown carnelian, one line of nasta'liq «محمد نبي الله» with dotted fillers, beaded bezel, open shank of swept/twisted bars (cage) closing to a plain band at the back, silver/palladium-tone. No catalog piece has this stone and inscription: no facts_en hit for «نبي», and none of the carnelians on any ring board (RS, R, HS, H, B) shows a single-line «محمد نبي الله» in a cage shank.
candidates_rejected: g3-33 (#557, #558): the only piece with the same mount model (beaded bezel on a swept twisted-wire cage shank), but its stone is a milky chalcedony with a frosted figural/script intaglio, not a carnelian reading «محمد نبي الله». Same model, different stone, so not the same object. g6-25 (#1143-1146): carnelian on a split three-wire shank, but plain unbeaded bezel and vertical-oval floral nasta'liq. g6-13 (#1086-1090): rock crystal with 8 lines on a diagonal-bar shank. g6-39 (#1235): carnelian with 5-line Nad-e Ali on a vertical-bar cage.

evidence: Engraving: central oval cartouche with «الله اكبر» on a cross-hatched ground (the carved/'نحت' part), surrounded by a dense border inscription in fine ijaza script (the engraved/'نقش' part). Letterforms and layout are identical to #21 (rotated 90°). The same dark inclusion sits just beside the alif at the end of the cartouche, the same dark patch is at the lower-left edge of the stone, and the border lines break in the same places. Mount: beaded bezel on fan-fluted (gadrooned) shoulders with a plain band, silver-tone, as in #19/#21. Compared video f6-f8 with #19 and #21 at w1600.
candidates_rejected: g1-44 (#182): red carnelian with central «علي» and stars, Biglou fan-rib openwork. g2-11 (#270): central «الله» only, cross-hatched diamond shoulders, gold-tone. g3-10, g4-06, g5-13 (other fluted-shank carnelians): different inscriptions.

evidence: Engraving: two-line thuluth shahada «لا اله الا الله / محمد رسول الله» divided by the long kashida of محمد. The initial flourish at top right, the alif/lam spacing, «رسول الله» on the second line and the trailing strokes all match #1163 stroke for stroke. Mount: double beaded bezel over a gallery of scroll/teardrop piercings, fan/sunburst ribbed openwork shoulders with a half-round central knob, and gilt inner surfaces visible through the openwork in #1163 (gold-tone line at the inner rim in #1170). This is the video's two-tone look. Compared v08 f5, f7, f9, f23, f25 with #1163, #1166, #1170 at w1600. The stone looks paler and creamier in the video because of lighting; it is light honey-brown in the photos.
candidates_rejected: g5-06, g5-08, g5-14 (Biglou pale-honey rings with ribbed shoulders): central panel plus border inscriptions, not the two-line shahada, and no gilt interior. g5-44: shahada on white agate, but a heavy-rib teardrop mount (that is v14). g6-29: shahada in a cartouche with a border, plain dome mount.

evidence: Engraving: nasta'liq «ومن يتوكل على الله فهو حسبه» inside a lobed cartouche frame with small flower/dot fillers. Word placement (ومن at right, يتوكل above, the large على الله bowls, فهو at left, حسبه on top) and the cartouche lobes are identical to #1180 and #1181. Mount: beaded bezel, shoulders knurled in a diamond lattice, plain smooth back band, silver. Matches #1180-#1182. Compared v10 f5 with #1181 at w1600.
candidates_rejected: g5-47 (#997): yellow agate in a lattice mount, but multi-line naskh Surat al-Nas. g1-17 (#61): yellow agate, four vertical naskh columns, gold-tone quilted mount. g3-11: yellow agate in nasta'liq but fan openwork shoulders.

evidence: Engraving: about five lines of thuluth/naskh, «بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم / ما شاء الله لا قوة الا بالله / ...استغفر الله... / ...». Line breaks, the tall alifs and the bottom-line flourishes are identical to #1153 and #1154. Stone: cushion-oval two-layer agate, whitish skin over orange, as described for g6-28. Mount: beaded bezel on scale/arch (fish-scale) openwork shoulders and a plain back band, silver. Matches #1153-#1155. Compared v12 f25 with #1153 at w1600.
candidates_rejected: g6-14 (#1091): same scale-openwork model, but brown banded agate with bold «أليس الله بكاف عبده». g6-18 (#1110): two-line thuluth on checkerboard shoulders. g6-38: scale/petal mount, red carnelian in nasta'liq.

evidence: Engraving: two-line thuluth shahada «لا اله الا الله / محمد رسول الله» with the long ruled kashida. Letter positions and the little star/dot fillers match #985. Stone: elongated horizontal oval translucent milky-white/honey agate. Mount: heavy ribbed claws all round the bezel, a teardrop piercing at each side of the bezel, and a deeply fluted silver shank with a plain back. Matches #985-#987. Compared v14 f7 with #985 at w1600.
candidates_rejected: g6-19 (#1114): milky chalcedony in a deep vertical-fluted mount, but the inscription is «لا اله الا الله الملك الحق المبين», the stone shape is different and there are no teardrop piercings. g3-27 (#535): milky chalcedony with «بسم الله / نصر من الله», milgrain bezel. g7-06, g7-10: milky chalcedony on diagonally fluted shanks, different text.

evidence: Same physical ring and same footage as v38 (per-frame mean pixel difference on the ring region is 0.6-1.0, against 6.5-12 between neighbouring frames; only the caption changes, a spacing fix in «الإجازه يرجع»). Video: horizontal oval honey-yellow agate engraved with Basmala plus Surat al-Ikhlas in 4-5 lines («بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم قل / هو الله احد الله الصمد / لم يلد ولم يولد ولم يكن له / كفوا احد» with numerals «١١..» on the last line), small milgrain bezel on a tall domed silver shank covered all over with fine vertical striations, with no side lugs. No catalog piece has both this stone and this mount.
candidates_rejected: g3-07 (#455): nearly the same 4-line Ikhlas composition with «١١» numerals, but (a) the last line differs: in the video, dotted fillers sit before a long flat-topped «كفو» near the right edge, while g3-07's «كفوا» starts right at the edge with a curled tail and no dots, and the video's cutting is thinner; (b) the mount is completely different: warm gold-tone Biglou frame with side tabs, large ball beads and fan ribs. Most likely the same workshop's standard Ikhlas layout (also on g3-01, g3-05 and g4-14), not the same stone. g4-14 (#637): Ikhlas with a date, in three ruled lines, Biglou silver mount with scrolled lugs and a radiating fluted shank. g3-01 (#426): Ikhlas, gold-tone Biglou. g3-14 (#486): pale honey agate on a fine-ribbed shank, but dense ruled lines (Ayat al-Kursi?). g6-10 (#1070): yellow agate, Ahl al-Bayt names, wide ribs. g7-29 (#1361): striped shank, grey-brown stone with «انه من سليمان».

evidence: Confirmed the same object as v34: identical footage, with frame-for-frame mean pixel difference 0.6-1.0 on the ring region. Only the burned-in caption text changes (spacing fix in «الإجازه يرجع»). Same Ikhlas-engraved honey agate in a fine-striated silver dome ring, and not found in the catalog. See v34 for the search.

Video: large domed horizontal-oval milky white/pale-honey chalcedony. Central oval cartouche with two lines «لا اله الا انت سبحانك / اني كنت من الظالمين» (Dhikr Yunus); border inscription is Nad-e Ali «ناد عليا مظهر العجائب تجده عونا لك في النوائب...». Mount: tall layered pointed scale/petal claws in silver, with scrolled openwork at the back of the shank. No catalog piece has this stone, layout and mount.
candidates_rejected: g6-38 (#1229): same type of layered scale/petal claw mount, but deep-red carnelian in nasta'liq «عز من قنع ذل من طمع». g6-20 (#1118): scale openwork, orange carnelian. g7-15 (#1288) and g5-16 (#870): Dhikr Yunus text, but red carnelians in other mounts. g3-18, g3-23, g6-39: Nad-e Ali in line layouts, not cartouche-plus-border. g5-29 (#914): large rock crystal, ruled multi-line text, scalloped claws on a fluted shank. g5-56 (#1028): pale grey agate, cross-hatched central invocation, fluted shoulders. g6-19, g7-06, g7-10, g3-27: milky chalcedony with different text and mounts.
